- **Uniqueness & Disjoint Neighborhoods:** Kernel proves `ovoid_unique` and `spread_unique`. [`OvoidSpreadCloneCapacity.adjacent_centers_unique`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/formal/DegreeDiameter/Portfolio/OvoidSpreadCloneCapacity.lean#L12-L28) proves that every source vertex (old or helper) is adjacent to **at most one** chosen center. Thus, distinct center open neighborhoods are completely disjoint (load $\le 1$).
- **Center Independence Not Required:** The 4225 centers induce $2080 K_2 + 65 \text{ isolates}$ (not an independent set). The proof relies strictly on disjoint neighborhoods and non-adjacent clone lifts, not center independence.

  - 65 diagonal roots: $(1, 81, 5249, 341184)$
  - 4160 off-diagonal roots: $(1, 81, 5329, 341104)$
- **All-Pairs & Homomorphism:** Routes between clones use old-source interior paths; adjacent centers $z_c, z_d$ connect via $z_c - d - c - z_d$. Exact diameter 3 is established via the genuine graph homomorphism `collapseHom` (mapping clones to centers), which preserves the accepted source non-$D2$ witness $[42705, 43363]$.
- **External Binding:** [`EXTERNAL_INPUT_BINDING.json`](file:///inspire/hdd/global_user/mahaitong-240108120090/ar4math/research/ddp/two_successful_methods_20261101/retained_edge_transfer/even_q8_gq_source80_81/balanced_full_ovoid_copy82/formalization/EXTERNAL_INPUT_BINDING.json) validates the 65 ovoid IDs, 585 ovoid-owner entries, 585 line-owner entries, and all 4225 ordered center labels.

- **Material Mismatch:** None. Candidate graph is simple, loopless, and exactly matches the formal clone specifications.
